theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratios cover fund management, administration, and operational costs. Lower ratios mean more of your money stays invested.
caption: Every fund charges fees to manage your portfolio. These costs directly impact your long-term wealth accumulation. Know what you're paying for. #MutualFundBasics #ExpenseRatio #InvestingEducation #FundLiteracy #SmartInvesting
